svg.title: Figure 1A — Histologic progression and qualitative program states
svg.desc: Native editable vector reconstruction. Normal, AAH, AIS, MIA and LUAD morphology; four qualitative program rows. Every cell membrane, nucleus, tissue contour, label and program segment is a separate vector object. No raster assets, external resources or scripts. Program intensity is schematic, not a quantitative scale.

g.title: AIS — continuous lepidic lining without stromal invasion
MIA — predominantly lepidic growth and one localized invasive focus
LUAD — invasive glands in reactive stroma
